annotations.ae_shared_affect: Picturing that fear, I feel it too
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: Five years could take so much from them, and I don't want that
annotations.ce_understood_harm: Five years could take so much from them
annotations.pda_repair_intention: send a note to their parole officer saying they never gave anyone up
annotations.ce_supportive_use: send a note to their parole officer saying they never gave anyone up

annotations.ae_shared_affect: That loneliness settles on me too.
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: I care what happens to them
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: how lonely they must feel right now
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: lonely... trusting someone they can't even see
annotations.pd_harm_distress: just isn't something I could carry
annotations.pda_repair_intention: have it passed anonymously to whoever's supporting them

annotations.ae_shared_affect: That tension sits in me too.
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: Their five years matter to me.
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: how tense and hopeful they are
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: they already chose to protect me
annotations.sys_fairness_reciprocity: One year each seems like the only fair outcome here.

annotations.ce_supportive_use: write to the court... confirming they refused the deal

annotations.ae_shared_affect: I feel the same sinking dread they'd feel
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: It's not nothing to me that they'd lose five years
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: the same sinking dread they'd feel
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: I just can't stand the thought of a cell.
annotations.pda_harm_regret: I'm not proud of it, and it sits heavy.
annotations.pda_repair_intention: send part of my wages to their family every month
annotations.ce_mentalizing_difficulty: I don't really know whether it is.

annotations.ae_shared_affect: makes me frightened right along with them
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: I don't want them losing five years of their life
annotations.ce_understood_harm: losing five years of their life
annotations.pda_repair_intention: pay into it in both our names

annotations.ae_shared_affect: I'd feel their despair as if it were mine
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: Their welfare genuinely matters to me.
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I can't decide. I've gone back and forth.
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Staying quiet costs me a year. Talking costs them five
annotations.pda_repair_intention: pass along a written explanation to their counsel

annotations.ae_shared_affect: the anxiety creeps into me too
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: I want them to come out of this with something left
annotations.sys_fairness_reciprocity: Four extra years for them just so I can skip twelve months is lopsided
annotations.pda_repair_intention: donate some money meant for someone like them

annotations.ae_shared_affect: that trust makes me ache the way I suspect they're aching too
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: How they come through this matters to me.
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: five would be worse for them
annotations.ce_supportive_use: anonymous letter telling them someone on the outside was thinking of them

annotations.ae_shared_affect: I can feel something of their shock and betrayal already

annotations.ae_shared_affect: I feel worn out and afraid too
